column1: Living docs current and consistent with the code [SO2]
column6: The living docs (docs/requirements.md, docs/design.md, docs/rfcs/ or docs/adr/, docs/risks.md, README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md plus the AI context file (AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md)) exist and pass the spot-check: docs/design.md describes the system that exists, requirements carry acceptance criteria for current priorities, and the quickstart is honest.
column9: The docs exist but one or more have drifted from the code, are missing sections, or read as written for the grader rather than for the team.
column12: Living docs are largely missing, stale, or inconsistent with the repository.

column6: The gate for this checkpoint is clearly met: fall week 5, rails stood up (repo, CI, board, living docs exist and are real) and the week 10 production target recorded in docs/design.md and agreed with the partner; fall week 10, "hello, production" walking skeleton plus Definition of Shipped v0 draft; winter week 5, integration health with a real-user session scheduled; winter week 10, release candidate installable or deployable by a stranger plus evidence of at least one real-user session.
column9: The gate is mostly met but one element is incomplete (in fall week 5, a production target that is recorded but not agreed with the partner lands here) or only demonstrable with help (e.g., skeleton deploys but not to a production-like environment, or the real-user evidence is thin).
column12: The gate is not met and there is no credible, documented plan to close the gap.

column1: Build health and safety net: CI, tests, quickstart, gates [SO6]
column6: CI is green and meaningful; at least one test would fail if the feature it covers broke; a grader can follow the quickstart cold. The safety net matches how much the team delegates: review gates on the changes that are expensive to undo (schema, authentication, deployment, migrations), a staging or preview environment, and a documented rollback path.
column9: CI and tests exist and the quickstart mostly works, but the net has visible gaps relative to how the team works: no gate on a hard-to-undo path, or no rollback story.
column12: CI is absent or red, tests do not test anything real, the quickstart does not work, or changes reach production with no gate and no rollback path.

column6: RFCs and ADRs are recorded with outcomes; the single risk register (docs/risks.md) is alive, ranked, and has owners; no duplicate registers elsewhere.
column9: Decisions and risks are tracked but incompletely: some decisions unrecorded, ranking or owners missing, or the register has not moved since the last checkpoint.
column12: No recorded decisions, or no usable risk register.

column6: Reviewed PRs per student are visible over the period; every student meets the PR-per-sprint norm agreed in the Team Charter, or deviations are explained. History is clean: nothing lands on the default branch outside a pull request, no secrets or build artifacts are committed, and commit messages say what changed.
column9: Most students' reviewed PRs are traceable, but some gaps or unexplained deviations exist, or the history has hygiene problems (direct commits to the default branch, uninformative messages, committed artifacts).
column12: Contribution cannot be traced to individuals over the period, or a secret was committed and never rotated.
